case.summary: Verdict is fraud (p=0.92) for an undocumented multi-card micro-skimming pattern on card C12975-K2. Customer C12975 explicitly disputed transaction 3660260, which belongs to a 6-transaction episode (3660255–3660260) totaling $23.99 that links to a 17-card micro-charge skimming wave. Although the low dollar amounts individual transactions appear subtle, recurring checks excluded R7. Recommend blocking card C12975-K2 (L1) and filing a SAR (L2).

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is submitted under internal case ID AC-HHF-004 to document an undocumented coordinated micro-charge skimming fraud pattern. The activity involves customer C12975 and debit card C12975-K2, which was targeted in a multi-card micro-skimming wave linked to 16 other cards including C00129-K1, C00348-K1, C01326-K2, C03427-K2, C03488-K1, C03611-K2, C04274-K1, C04528-K1, C05083-K1, C05263-K2, C06198-K1, C09471-K2, C10035-K2, C10654-K1, C11332-K1, and C13290-K1. On 2017-01-05 at 11:33, an online charge of $3.51 for product code C occurred in region 191.0 under transaction 3660255. Subsequent online charges occurred on 2017-01-07 at 10:03 ($5.18, transaction 3660256, region 191.0), on 2017-01-14 at 14:57 ($2.66, transaction 3660257, region 191.0), on 2017-01-18 at 14:42 ($4.75, transaction 3660258, region 191.0), on 2017-01-22 at 13:22 ($4.99, transaction 3660259, region 191.0, using device profile rv:11.0 | NULL | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL), and on 2017-01-26 at 15:09 ($2.90, transaction 3660260, region 337.0). This repeated series of small online ProductCD='C' transactions across 17 cards forms a low-and-slow skimming scheme that is inconsistent with standard card usage. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (1 earlier closed case(s), none reported). OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. The agent opened an internal case, initiated monitoring on connected cards, and escalated the case to an analyst; a block of card C12975-K2 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious exposure of $23.99.
